title: Enhancing Graph Representations Learning with Decorrelated Propagation

problem.claim: Deep GNNs can suffer from over-correlation, in which learned representations become highly correlated after feature transformation and propagation.

gap.claim: Existing decorrelation solutions may fail to maintain low feature correlation and may encode redundant information.

contributions.claim: The propagation operator in GNNs exacerbates feature correlation.
The paper proposes DeProp, a decorrelated propagation scheme that performs feature decorrelation at the propagation step.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that DeProp integrates easily with prevalent GNNs and improves performance on multiple real-world datasets.
The authors report that DeProp simultaneously addresses over-smoothing and over-correlation and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on missing-feature settings.
The authors report that code is available in a public repository.

narrative_sequence.summary: GNNs are widely used for representation learning on graph-structured data.
The paper frames over-correlation as a limitation of GNNs alongside over-smoothing.
The authors re-examine over-correlation empirically and theoretically, showing that propagation exacerbates feature correlation and that existing solutions may leave redundant information.
The authors propose DeProp to decorrelate feature learning during propagation.
Experiments report integration with prevalent GNNs, performance improvements, simultaneous mitigation of over-smoothing and over-correlation, and gains on missing-feature settings.

source_observation.claim: The propagation step can increase feature correlation in deep GNNs.

interpretation.claim: Representation quality may depend on controlling correlation during propagation, not only after feature learning.

application.claim: When designing graph representation models, consider decorrelation mechanisms integrated directly into propagation.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether propagation-time decorrelation is effective across graph domains beyond the reported datasets and settings.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the theoretical results or assumptions.
The abstract does not identify the datasets, baselines, metrics, or quantitative performance values.
The abstract does not describe the DeProp algorithm in implementation detail.
